title: GPU node rotation and mixed autoscaler Terraform module for private VPCs
creator: Marco Li
description: Create a single, opinionated Terraform module that provisions and manages GPU node groups in customer VPCs with dual-mode autoscaling support (ASG + Karpenter). The module must support safe node rotation for driver/OS upgrades, deterministic healthchecks, mixed instance types (on-demand + spot/interruptible), and predictable fallbacks to maintain capacity. Deliver infra code, test harness, and upgrade playbook for Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Module can create GPU nodegroups in a private VPC using either ASG or Karpenter mode via a single configuration flag
Supports mixed instance types and spot fallback without violating SLOs (automated test demonstrating successful fallback)
Node rotation flow performs cordon+drain, kubelet-health validation, driver install via DaemonSet and post-rotation e2e checks
Healthhook endpoints and cloudwatch/prometheus metrics emitted for node lifecycle transitions
Terraform tests (terratest or kitchen-terraform) validate idempotency, upgrade path, and destruction in CI
Documentation and runbook added to Confluence and included in release notes
tasks: Design module interface: inputs/outputs, IAM role shapes, tagging conventions
Implement ASG path with launch template and lifecycle hooks for graceful termination
Implement Karpenter path configuration with provisioner CRD integration and taint/label templates
Add cloud-init script and driver bootstrap DaemonSet manifest templating
Build node-rotation script and expose as a terraform null_resource provisioner for ops-runbooks
Create automated tests that simulate spot interruptions and node drains
Integrate health checks: kubelet readiness, GPU driver presence, node-exporter metrics
Author upgrade playbook and rollback steps for driver/AMI upgrades
Peer review and security review for IAM role scoping and SSM/KMS access
comments: 2026-02-25 - Marco Li: Kickoff. Initial design doc uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/internal/private-iac/gpu-node-rotation. Decided to support both ASG and Karpenter behind module flag to preserve customer choice.
2026-03-02 - Aisha Rahman: Implemented ASG launch template path and lifecycle hook prototype. Observed 12s additional termination window required for driver's graceful unload during tests.
2026-03-04 - SRE Review (Janet O.): Suggested adding kubelet health gating to prevent cycles of repeated drain failures. Added task to emit node rotation events to observability.
2026-03-06 - Marco Li: Trade-off discussion: Karpenter provides faster scale-up but lacks lifecycle hooks - added a controller-runner pattern to attach pre-drain checks when in karpenter mode.
2026-03-09 - Security (Mateo R.): Flagged IAM role for node bootstrap with kms:Decrypt and ssm:GetParameter. Marked security_review_required = true and requested least-privilege matrix.

2026-03-10 - Aisha Rahman: Began terratest harness. Found an edge case where mixed instance pools with GPU types and different AMIs required node-label normalization. Added normalization step to templates.
notes: Aim to reduce customer-visible capacity blips during upgrades to <1% of requests over 30m. Plan a staged rollout with feature-flagged provisioning for top 10 customers before general availability. Include metrics dashboard in Console: per-node rotation success rate and time-to-ready.
